ancestry.parent_alias_invariant: At runtime require model.pt epoch 1 and tensor-equality with model_ep1.pt; this was also verified before freezing H233.

basis.independent_implementation: New implementation using this repository’s own PyTorch GRU, event features, split loader, sequence dataset, propensity weighting, and metric contract. No teammate code or weights were used.

commands.admission: All command arrays are prepared worker argv only; they require a new root-owned attempt, fresh device/quota gates, and the existing signed campaign resource/dispatch admission. This file grants no launch permission.

hypothesis: A compact causal event-context interaction on the frozen parent representation may improve the primary prediction pair, or provide a useful conditional teacher view, without changing parent weights. Standalone score, teacher usefulness, and served blend value remain distinct outcomes.
interpretation_limits: Fold 0 was already exposed and is development evidence only.
A readout with lower standalone score may still merit a separate conditional teacher/blend test.
No local change is a public score forecast.
No serving-runtime or Rust CPU integration claim is made.

objective.label: y_clip = clip(y, -2, 2)
objective.loss: sum(w * square(readout_pair - target)) / max(sum(w), 1e-8) within each 2000-row chunk
objective.main_row_weight: reuse train_rnn.main_row_weights with same-fold propensity cache, prop_power=2, prop_eps=0.03, valid_true_mask=0.03; mask_weight=false
objective.official_metric: global_wp_clip2_v1, unchanged; evaluation is external and fold 0 is previously exposed.
objective.parent_auxiliary_training_losses: Removed because the entire parent is frozen; parent auxiliary outputs and weights remain preserved.
objective.source: E511 C1 seed-3 main distilled wMSE/chunk treatment

profile: one JSON receipt with attempts/completions/loss and gradient finite checks, CUDA/cuDNN versions, memory and chunk rate
outputs.transactionality: Profile and run destinations are never overwritten. Epoch checkpoints and provenance use atomic rename. Exports stage in a sibling .partial directory and commit only after full row-count, hash, and parent-anchor parity checks.

parent_architecture.frozen_outputs: All 23 parent channels remain in every checkpoint; only channels 0:2 are adjusted and graded.
parent_architecture.input_order: raw112 followed by the parent FEATURE_NAMES event context99 in the exact order below

parent_fit_membership.membership_rule: Sets must exactly equal campaign_split.train_groups and campaign_split.valid_groups; assert_fit_groups verifies no component overlaps evaluation groups.
parent_fit_membership.source: parent provenance fit_row_groups and the exact campaign fold-0 split manifest

readout.context_source: same 99 causal event features already present in the parent 211-column input; no future/target-derived context

controls.additive: rank-32 hidden projection plus rank-32 event-context projection; additive residual to parent pair
controls.conditional_residual: rank-32 hidden, context, and elementwise-product features fused into an additive pair residual
controls.hidden_only: rank-32 projection of frozen [recurrent, projected-input] state; additive residual to parent pair
controls.multiplicative: Hadamard product of rank-32 hidden/context projections; parent pair scaled by 1+tanh(correction)

readout.final_pair_projection: zero-initialized for every readout; all endpoints equal the anchor before the first update
readout.hidden_representation: concatenate the GRU recurrent output (256) with the projected input (256), width 512
readout.parameter_count_note: Equal allocated size per control; hidden-only intentionally leaves the context branch disconnected.
readout.shared_trunk_pass: one no_grad frozen-parent chunk pass feeds all four controls; parent recurrent state streams across 2000-row chunks

resource_caps.admission_note: These are resource ceilings for a future root-owned worker packet, not measurements or authorization. No GPU access was available in this code-only preparation session.
resource_caps.fit_output_estimate: Four validation pair arrays at (1873, 20000, 2) float32 are approximately 1.2 GB combined plus the boolean selected mask; export is not part of the profile.

scope: A bounded own-weight readout experiment on the fixed own C1 seed-3 epoch-1 GRU. Source code, recipe, and CPU correctness tests are prepared only. Root owns any later admission and fit.

training.amp_scaler: none: trainable readout math is FP32; only detached frozen trunk uses autocast
training.membership: all 10,535 permitted train groups plus all 1,405 fit-dev valid groups, shuffled with seed-3 DataLoader generator
training.parent_trunk: requires_grad=false; eval(); all chunk forward operations under torch.no_grad()
training.resume: epoch-boundary continuation from the full model_ep0.pt checkpoint, including AdamW, loader generator, and RNG state
training.schedule: constant for this H233 readout screen
training.scientific_difference_from_parent: Readout-only frozen continuation removes structural/next-change auxiliary losses and uses the exact requested constant 1e-3 LR rather than parent OneCycle LR.

validation.local_cpu_tests: tests/test_conditional_readout.py: 5 passed; run with one-CPU affinity and a parent RSS watch that killed above 1,536,000 KiB; observed peak 867,936 KiB.
